description_en: Invokes AttachClassicLinkVpc to connect a classic network type instance to a virtual private cloud (VPC) so that the instance can communicate with cloud resources in the VPC through private network peering
description_zh: 调用AttachClassicLinkVpc将一台经典网络类型实例连接到专有网络VPC中，使经典网络类型实例可以和VPC中的云资源私网互通
kebab_example: aliyun ecs attach-classic-link-vpc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1gtjxuuvwj17zr0000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1j4z1sr8zxu4l8u0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachClassicLinkVpc

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the classic network type instance. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25506.html to query your active instances
parameters.help_zh: 经典网络类型实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25506.html查看您可用的实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC for which you enable ClassicLink. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html to query your active VPCs
parameters.help_zh: 开启ClassicLink的VPC ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html查看您可用的VPC
parameters.name: vpc_id
